$comment: The single source for every payment field on this site. The address, the QR image, the dogecoin: URI and the explorer link are all checked against this file by CI — a payment address is a financially irreversible field, so it is data with a test, not markup.
notes: Payments are irreversible. Verify the address against this file and against the repository history before sending.
AxonOS will never ask for a seed phrase or a private key.
A payment is identified by its transaction id together with an order id.
